manifest.method: Manual aligned binary parse of 5 MapBiomeSettings; AssetReference GUIDs resolved against decoded ResourceDatabase
manifest.validation: All five objects consumed to exact byte length; generated tree cannot parse AssetReference, manual decoder follows metadata field order. Not re-encoded or gameplay tested.
manifest.scope: Sandbox mappings; overrides and shared defaults not fully recovered

biomes.name: Drylands
biomes.source_scope: sandbox biome configuration; campaign/challenge overrides not recovered

special_needs_and_hazards.text: The conditions of the Drylands are a challenge for outlanders. Being dehydrated for too long will result in death. Satisfying this need activates the {UI.Boost.Hydration.WithIcon}, making it easier to satisfy every other need.

limitations: Crops are explicitly listed field prefabs; this does not establish ordinary outdoor farm compatibility, yields, growth rates, or availability in every level.
Resource sources are map spawn definitions, not a complete inventory of obtainable resources. Fish decoration entries are visual spawning and do not alone establish fish resource availability.
Shared base placeables may add content beyond these biome-specific lists.

There's no farming or foraging in the Winterlands.
You'll need to trap animals to get <style=Input>{ResourceCategory.Food.WithIcon}</style>.
